# Muster

> Muster is a self-hosted alert grouping and on-call service that sits after Alertmanager.
> It groups Alerts into Alert Groups, the problems people act on; keeps one editable message per Alert Group in Mattermost, in Slack, in Telegram, in any other messenger through a Bridge, or behind an outgoing webhook; and lets people acknowledge, resolve and snooze Alert Groups.
>
> This file is the index of the documentation of Muster for AI agents and coding assistants, for version `latest`. Read the pages it links, each the Markdown version of a page of the site, and the specifications, and do not rely on your training data about Muster.

## Start here

- [`api/openapi.yaml`](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/api/openapi.yaml) is the HTTP API and [`api/bridge.yaml`](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/api/bridge.yaml) the Bridge protocol; where a page and a specification disagree, the specification wins.
- The rules for agents (the error classes, waits, presses, idempotency, edit windows and when a bridge is finished) and the scenarios, each the pages to read in order and what finishes it, are in [the guide for agents](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/llms-full-guide.txt); read it before the pages.

### Install

- [Install with Helm](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/install/helm.md): The Helm chart runs Muster on Kubernetes 1.30 or newer.
- [The database](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/install/database.md): Muster keeps everything in PostgreSQL 14 or newer, and nothing else stateful: no Redis and no queue.
- [Requirements and tested versions](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/install/versions.md): What Muster needs, which versions it was checked against, how its own versions are numbered, and how…

- [Proxies](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/messengers/proxies.md): Muster has no proxy for the whole installation.
- [Connect a messenger through a bridge](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/messengers/bridge.md): A **bridge** connects Muster to a messenger that Muster does not support natively.
- [Write a bridge](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/messengers/write-a-bridge.md): A **bridge** connects Muster to a messenger that Muster does not support natively.

### Concepts

- [Alert Groups](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/concepts/alert-groups.md): An **Alert Group** is a set of Alerts that Muster treats as one problem.
- [Routes and Group keys](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/concepts/routes-and-group-keys.md): A **Route** decides what happens to an Alert after Muster has read it: which Alert Group it joins…
- [Snapshot semantics](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/concepts/snapshot-semantics.md): Alertmanager does not tell Muster "this alert started" and "this alert stopped" as separate events.
- [Loud and Quiet](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/concepts/loud-and-quiet.md): Every change to an Alert Group is either **Loud** or **Quiet**.
- [Statuses and commands](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/concepts/statuses-and-commands.md): An Alert Group is always in one of four statuses, and only a few things move it from one to another.
- [Broken Destinations](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/concepts/broken-destinations.md): A Destination is **Broken** when Muster has decided that it cannot deliver there until something…
- [Teams](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/concepts/teams.md): A **Team** says who owns what: Routes and Destinations may name the Team that owns them, so that…
- [Routing to Teams](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/concepts/routing-to-teams.md): One Route can serve many teams.
- [How an alert reaches people](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/concepts/how-an-alert-reaches-people.md): This page follows one Alert from the moment Alertmanager sends it to the moment a person…
- [What critical changes](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/concepts/what-critical-changes.md): An Alert Group whose Severity level is **critical** is **Urgent**.
- [Schedules](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/concepts/schedules.md): A **Schedule** says who in a Team is On-call and when.
- [Notification rules](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/concepts/notification-rules.md): A **Notification rule** says how a Page reaches a person.
- [Escalation chains](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/concepts/escalation-chains.md): An **Escalation chain** Pages more and more people while an Alert Group stays firing.
- [Whom a message mentions](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/concepts/mentions.md): Mention entries say who is mentioned.

- [MusterDown](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/operations/runbooks/MusterDown.md): Prometheus cannot scrape a Muster replica: the target of the job `muster` is down.
- [MusterNoLeader](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/operations/runbooks/MusterNoLeader.md): Every replica of Muster reports that it is not the Leader.
- [MusterDeliveryFailing](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/operations/runbooks/MusterDeliveryFailing.md): A Destination has deliveries waiting and has not had a successful delivery for 10 minutes.

- [MusterDeliveryQueueGrowing](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/operations/runbooks/MusterDeliveryQueueGrowing.md): A Destination has more than 100 deliveries waiting, and the number keeps growing.
- [MusterIngestBacklog](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/operations/runbooks/MusterIngestBacklog.md): Processing falls behind ingestion: more than 1,000 Stored Snapshots wait to be processed, or the…
- [MusterIngestRejected](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/operations/runbooks/MusterIngestRejected.md): Muster refused ingestion requests within 15 minutes: an oversized one, or more than 10 without a…
- [MusterIngestSnapshotFailed](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/operations/runbooks/MusterIngestSnapshotFailed.md): Stored Snapshots of an Integration failed in processing.
- [MusterTemplateError](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/operations/runbooks/MusterTemplateError.md): A template failed to render.
- [MusterClockSkew](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/operations/runbooks/MusterClockSkew.md): A replica's clock differs from the database clock by more than 2 seconds.
- [MusterLoginFailures](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/operations/runbooks/MusterLoginFailures.md): A burst of failed sign-ins: more than 20 for one method within 10 minutes.
- [MusterScheduleGap](https://muster-io.github.io/muster/latest/operations/runbooks/MusterScheduleGap.md): A Schedule has a **gap** now or one that starts within the next 7 days…
